lines_of_business: Medica Central plans; 'may or may not be covered by all'; Medicare/Medicaid follow program rules if different
sections_in_order: Coverage Policy (Rental, Purchase, Replacement, Accessories, Supplies, Convenience Items)
criteria_location: Coverage Policy (p.1-2) for rental/purchase logic; OSAHS diagnostic thresholds are in the Description (p.2-3), not in the criteria section; compliance definition also in Description.

k_of_n.quote: Between five and 14 events per hour and is accompanied by documentation of at least one of the following: a. Excessive daytime sleepiness ... g. History of stroke.

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Convenience items 'generally considered NOT COVERED' (duplicate travel device, battery backup, travel plug adapter).
logic.initial_vs_repeat: 3-month initial rental, then purchase or return in month four; replacement covered when made necessary by normal wear.

and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Literal <OR> markup; not a criterion about the patient

Greater than or equal to 15 events per hour, OR Between five and 14 events per hour
Excessive daytime sleepiness; Impaired cognition; Mood disorder; Insomnia; Hypertension; Ischemic heart disease or coronary artery disease; History of stroke
written verification of: Diagnosis of OSAHS, and/or Usage compliance

thresholds.quote: Greater than or equal to 15 events per hour
Between five and 14 events per hour
greater than four hours of usage per night and 70% usage within a 30 day period

In month four it is required

Compliance paragraph in Description, not Coverage Policy
Long re-review date list in footer

Rental then forced buy-or-return decision at month 4 (no adherence gate in coverage text)
